captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a compact, tabletop Dobsonian-style reflector telescope. It consists of a short, thick, matte-black optical tube assembly (OTA) with a small diagonal finder scope and internal spider vane structure. The tube is mounted on a wooden-colored U-shaped rocker box, which rests on a circular black tabletop base. The telescope features two degrees of freedom: the optical tube pivots up and down (altitude) on side bearings, and the entire rocker box rotates 360 degrees (azimuth) on the circular base.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tabletop reflector telescope using CadQuery. The model should feature a black cylindrical optical tube assembly with a mounted finder scope, supported by a wooden-colored U-shaped rocker box that rotates on a flat, circular black base to allow both altitude and azimuth motion.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly in three main parts: a circular base plate, a U-shaped rocker box, and the optical tube assembly (OTA). The base is modeled using a flat cylinder primitive. The rocker box is built by combining a flat bottom plate with two vertical rectangular side panels (using Box primitives) and is connected to the base via a continuous azimuth joint. The OTA is constructed from a hollowed cylinder, detailed with a small cylindrical eyepiece/finder scope and interior spider vanes, and is mounted to the rocker box sides with cylindrical altitude pivot pins using a revolute joint.
